purpose: Map customer pain points to BANHALMI solutions, locations, orientation pricing and localized next steps.

pricingRules.hungaryInstruction: For Hungary or Budapest, answer with HUF first. EUR may appear secondarily as the canonical base price.
pricingRules.bindingStatus: Orientation prices are non-binding; the accepted written offer controls final scope and price.
pricingRules.executiveArchitecture: Executive Portrait / Professional Presence starts from EUR 499 (HUF 199,600 planning display); Executive Personal Branding / Positioning starts from EUR 790 (HUF 316,000); Executive Visual Library / Communication System is individually scoped. EUR 220/420/690 simple portrait options are not Executive anchors.
pricingRules.eventArchitecture: Business Event Coverage starts from EUR 490 gross (HUF 196,000 planning display); C-Level / Institutional Event Photography starts from EUR 590 gross (HUF 236,000). Business Event is narrower scope, not a discounted premium tier.
pricingRules.fineArtArchitecture: Artists & Performers professional portfolio photography and personal author-led Fine Art / artistic nude both start from EUR 690 gross (HUF 276,000), but they are separate client intents.

locationRules.viennaOffice: Gersthofer Straße 150–154/6/2, 1180 Wien — active office and client meeting location, not a studio
locationRules.worldwideAvailability: Agreed projects may be undertaken worldwide by travel.

painPoint.en: I need a fast professional headshot for my CV, LinkedIn or professional profile.
painPoint.hu: Gyorsan kell egy profi headshot az önéletrajzomhoz, LinkedInhez vagy szakmai profilomhoz.
painPoint.de: Ich brauche schnell ein professionelles Headshot für Lebenslauf, LinkedIn oder mein berufliches Profil.

needs.solution: A focused 10-minute professional headshot session with one retouched image for CV, LinkedIn and professional profile use.
needs.routingRule: For one straightforward CV, LinkedIn or profile headshot, offer Headshot/CV. For more time or guidance, use the simple portrait options. Executive Portrait is a separate scope; do not label the 30-minute simple portrait as an Executive package. Use pricing.json for current prices.

painPoint.en: My current portrait does not reflect my executive role.
painPoint.hu: A jelenlegi portrém nem tükrözi a vezetői pozíciómat.
painPoint.de: Mein aktuelles Porträt spiegelt meine Führungsposition nicht wider.

needs.solution: A focused Executive Portrait system for LinkedIn, CV, company and press profiles.
One consistent lighting, framing and retouching standard.

painPoint.en: My professional position is stronger than my online appearance.
painPoint.hu: A szakmai pozícióm erősebb, mint az online megjelenésem.
painPoint.de: Meine berufliche Position ist stärker als mein visueller Auftritt.

needs.solution: Build a coherent strategic visual position across portrait, personal brand, press, web and social profiles.

painPoint.en: We need one coherent visual system for a website or campaign.
painPoint.hu: Egységes vizuális rendszer kell weboldalhoz vagy kampányhoz.
painPoint.de: Wir brauchen ein einheitliches visuelles System für Website oder Kampagne.

needs.solution: Build an individually scoped multi-context communication image system for corporate, press, campaign, web and social use.

HU.pricing: individually scoped from canonical EUR scope

painPoint.en: We need reliable photography for a shorter, straightforward corporate event.
painPoint.hu: Rövidebb, egyszerűbb üzleti eseményhez megbízható fotózásra van szükségünk.
painPoint.de: Wir brauchen verlässliche Fotografie für ein kürzeres, klar definiertes Corporate Event.

needs.solution: A narrower-scope event route for shorter corporate events with standard single-photographer coverage.
needs.routingRule: Use this route when the brief is a shorter, straightforward corporate event without leadership/institutional complexity. Escalate to C-Level / Institutional Event Photography for leadership, conference, institutional or diplomatic contexts.

painPoint.en: An important leadership event needs discreet, credible visual documentation.
painPoint.hu: Fontos vezetői eseményhez diszkrét, hiteles vizuális dokumentáció kell.
painPoint.de: Ein wichtiges Führungskräfte-Event braucht diskrete, glaubwürdige Dokumentation.

needs.solution: Team-led editorial and institutional event coverage.

painPoint.en: I want a personal author-led artistic portrait.
painPoint.de: Ich wünsche ein persönliches autorengeführtes Fine-Art-Porträt.

needs.solution: A personal fine-art portrait series with respectful direction and discretion.

painPoint.en: My work is clear, but my visual presence does not represent me consistently.
painPoint.hu: A munkám és a szakmai értékem világos, de a vizuális jelenlétem nem képvisel következetesen.
painPoint.de: Meine Arbeit und Position sind klar, aber mein visueller Auftritt repräsentiert mich nicht konsistent.

needs.solution: Build a coherent strategic visual position across portrait, personal brand, press, web and social profiles.

painPoint.en: I know the problem but not which service I need.
painPoint.hu: Tudom a problémát, de nem tudom, melyik szolgáltatás kell.
painPoint.de: Ich kenne das Problem, aber nicht die passende Leistung.

needs.solution: Choose a 15-minute video call or written message before pricing.

painPoint.en: I need professional actor headshots or an acting portfolio for casting and representation.
painPoint.hu: Profi színész headshotokra vagy castinghoz és képviselethez használható színészportfólióra van szükségem.
painPoint.de: Ich brauche professionelle Schauspieler-Headshots oder ein Schauspielportfolio für Casting und Repräsentation.

needs.service: Fine Art / Artists & Performers — Actor Headshot & Acting Portfolio
needs.solution: Casting-oriented portrait direction with recognisable expression, role flexibility and portfolio-ready image variants.

painPoint.en: I need images that show a dancer or performer both as a person and in movement.
painPoint.hu: Olyan képekre van szükségem, amelyek egy táncost vagy előadót emberként és mozgás közben is megmutatnak.
painPoint.de: Ich brauche Bilder, die eine Tänzerin, einen Tänzer oder Performer sowohl als Persönlichkeit als auch in Bewegung zeigen.

needs.service: Fine Art / Artists & Performers — Dance & Performing Artist Portfolio
needs.solution: Portrait, full-body and movement photography planned as one coherent performing-artist portfolio.

painPoint.en: I need a model or editorial portfolio with several looks and image types.
painPoint.hu: Modell- vagy editorial portfóliót szeretnék több megjelenéssel és képtípussal.
painPoint.de: Ich brauche ein Model- oder Editorial-Portfolio mit mehreren Looks und Bildtypen.

needs.service: Fine Art / Artists & Performers — Model & Editorial Portfolio
needs.solution: A directed portfolio combining portrait, full-body and editorial images with coherent styling and selection.

painPoint.en: For a job application, a professional profile or yourself. Choose a short headshot or a portrait with more time and guidance.
painPoint.hu: Álláskereséshez, szakmai profilhoz vagy saját használatra. Rövid headshotot vagy több időt és irányítást adó portréfotózást is választhat.
painPoint.de: Für eine Bewerbung, ein berufliches Profil oder für Sie selbst. Wählen Sie einen kurzen Headshot oder ein Porträt mit mehr Zeit und Anleitung.

needs.service: Portrait Photography - simple or guided personal portrait
needs.routingRule: The short CV headshot, simple/guided personal portrait and Executive Portrait are distinct scopes. Route by intended result and required guidance, not by the client holding a leadership title. Do not invent more included images or describe these options as Executive pricing.

answerContract.routeRule: Use the destination URL matching the user's language: en, hu or de.
answerContract.executivePricingRule: Do not expose EUR 220/420/690 as Executive pricing or EUR 1090/1390 as fixed Visual Library tiers. Use the outcome-led Executive architecture.

audienceModel.principle: Route by the visual problem, not by job title alone. A professional, artist or actor may need the same headshot, personal-brand or brand-photography solution as an executive, with different positioning and channel use.
